caption: The drawing features six distinct objects, each labeled and depicted in a brownish, iron-like color with a realistic, slightly rusted texture. The first object in the upper left is a “Hinge,” consisting of two flat, rectangular plates with a central hinge mechanism. In the top center is a large, vertically elongated decorative “Handle” with a pointed, symmetrical shape, several small diamond-shaped cutouts, and a small cross at the top. In the upper right is a “Bell Cord Guide” made up of two small, spindle-shaped components pierced by a vertical cord, with a small ornate element hanging from the cord. The lower row displays three more objects: On the left is an “Upper Bolt,” a long plate fitted with several rectangular guides and an attached horizontal bolt with a curled handle. In the bottom center is a “Lower Bolt,” similar in design but with a more prominent hooked end to the bolt and rectangular guides along the plate. The lower right features a small vertical plate. Each object is rendered in detail, and the drawing includes labeled titles beneath each item along with corresponding scale bars and the name "Geoffrey Holt" at the bottom right. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Hardware Details (of doors)
